chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Eat the oil, and massage with the oil, for it is from a Blessed tree'.

key_terms.الزَّيْت: Oil (specifically olive oil in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of olive oil in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith through a chain linking Imam al-Sadiq to the Prophet, emphasizing the olive tree's status as a 'blessed tree' (*shajarah mubarakah*). This narration not only validates the medicinal and culinary virtues of olive oil but also reinforces its spiritual significance as a symbol of divine light and purity in Shia tradition.
